name: Andafiavaratra Palace (Prime Minister's palace museum)
subtitle: A stone palace built for Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony, now partly a museum.

facts.label: Stone building
facts.value: Replaced a wooden first palace in 1872; supervised by British architect William Pool.

facts.label: Museum
facts.value: Ground-floor rooms house the Andafiavaratra Museum.

facts.label: Collection
facts.value: Main exhibits are objects rescued from the 1995 Rova fire.

parts.text: A stone palace built for Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony, now partly a museum. Its main exhibits are objects rescued from the 1995 Rova fire.
